title: AWS and Bluesight build AI for hospital 340B compliance
slides: How does AWS help hospitals track 340B savings?
Bluesight uses AI to monitor drug inventory in real time.
But 70% of hospitals miss compliance data until audits.
Your pharmacy can now automate 340B eligibility checks instantly.
Run a test on one drug class before next month's audit.
thread_text:
1. 70% miss the data

Hospitals don’t see 340B compliance gaps until an audit hits. That’s too late to fix lost savings.

2. AWS tracks the blind spot

Bluesight’s AI monitors drug inventory in real time. No more relying on quarterly spreadsheets.

3. Manual checks kill speed

Eligibility for 340B is still done by hand in most pharmacies. One misstep and you forfeit discounts.

4. AI cuts the audit panic

Automated eligibility checks run instantly per transaction. Compliance data surfaces before the deadline.

5. Test one drug class today

Pick a high-volume drug, run a 340B check via Bluesight. See if you’ve been missing savings before next month.
